question: Can an Oreshkov-Costa-Brukner noncausal process matrix produce unconditional bidirectional input-output correlations and violate a causal inequality, and does this constitute a physically recorded earlier output from a later independently chosen input?

source.paper: Oreshkov, Costa and Brukner, Quantum correlations with no causal order

process_model.W: 1/4 [I + v/sqrt(2) (I Z Z I + Z I X Z)]
process_model.validity: Trace W = 4. Anticommuting Pauli terms imply eigenvalues (1-v)/4 and (1+v)/4, each eightfold; positive semidefinite for 0<=v<=1.
process_model.local_alice_instrument: Measure Z with outcome x, reprepare Z eigenstate a
process_model.local_bob_instrument_task0: Measure X with outcome y, reprepare Z eigenstate b XOR y
process_model.local_bob_instrument_task1: Measure Z with outcome y, reprepare Z eigenstate 0
process_model.primary_statistic: Average of P(x=b|task=0) and P(y=a|task=1), retaining all outcomes

four_mandatory_scientific_gates.requirement: Late genuinely independent choice occurs strictly after the recorded early output
four_mandatory_scientific_gates.note: The formal OCB process has no certified A-before-B laboratory clock order. CPU is given b before calculating model probabilities.

four_mandatory_scientific_gates.requirement: All early outcomes are available without any postselection
four_mandatory_scientific_gates.note: The causal game includes all x,y outcome branches.

four_mandatory_scientific_gates.requirement: Early receiver is not given future message through parameters, data, seeds or leakage
four_mandatory_scientific_gates.note: The model's conditional P(x,y|a,b,task) explicitly receives Bob's b as input. No truly early physical receiver was tested.

four_mandatory_scientific_gates.requirement: Independent calculation then independent physical reproduction
four_mandatory_scientific_gates.note: Three CPU mathematics methods on two hosted Python runners; no physical OCB resource, clock attestation or independent laboratory.

interpretation.caution: Violating the OCB causal inequality does not establish that any lab output was fixed before the later freely chosen bit. The model violates a constraint of definite causal ordering; it is not a usable spacetime retro-message protocol.

next_test: Identify a physically realizable process that can be independently timestamped before a subsequently independent source selects the message; test all unfiltered early records and exclude both forward leakage and postselection before any claim of backward signaling.
